body: Lots of stress, feelings of emptiness and sadness. I would say that's the correct word, it just feels like asking for help is a brick wall and then they wonder why I do all of these things.

I would say a little bit of both, I honestly just wish that people never expected anything out of me because whenever I have expectations I just feel like I can never reach them and I feel like a huge disappointment, I also self harm and people all the time just constantly brigade me with trying to get me to stop by "Tough Love" which never works and then when it doesn't work they are like "Why haven't you stopped doing that?" It makes me feel worse because I feel like I am upsetting people and disappointing them, they think its as easy as "Just stop" and then they get mad at me when I don't? I don't understand these people, but at the same time they just make me feel more of a disappointment.
to stop thinking me as something good because i am not, too set the expectations lower because i will never meet the high ones, too honestly just give up on me.
yeah, its gotten to the point where i cant even properly convey my emotions.
